trans-unit.source: The page ID of the SysFolder in which frontend user records are stored. Header dropdown for login will only be rendered if this value is set.
The ID of the page where the fe_login plugin is located which is used to execute the reset-password-process. A "reset password"-link is only rendered if this value is set.
The color is used as the primary color of the layout.
The logo is used in the header. Formats other than SVG are also supported.
The subtitle of the website is used in the header.
